description: A client-side web app that turns story text and configurable storybook settings into a complete prompt based on the supplied prompt-template.txt, with a one-click copy action.

services.name: Web frontend
features: Provide inputs for story text, title, format, and target length.
Offer music style and other style-like settings as selectable lists with the ability to enter a custom value.
Generate the complete prompt from prompt-template.txt by substituting the entered values while preserving the template's fixed instructions.
Show the generated prompt and provide a copy-to-clipboard action with visible success or error feedback.
Run entirely in the browser without a backend.
